This parameter allows the operator to define the starting protocol for radio detection between OBSAI and CPRI variants.

When this parameter is set, the FHS will start the radio protocol detection algorithm with the specified protocol on the first startup or following upgrade activation of that module. The use of this parameter can reduce the radio detection time in configurations where the Operator knows the type of radio deployment. If this parameter is not specified, the FHS will still be able to automatically detect the type of radio protocols in use, although the time to detect the radios may be increased for certain exceptional cases. In this scenario, the FHS will attempt to use prior radio detection information to select the starting point for protocol searches.

Since this parameter defines the starting point for the search algorithm, it can only decrease the detection time for radios that are attached to the FHS when the algorithm is started. If no radios are attached to the module, the time to detect the radios will be dependent upon the radio protocol type and the current protocol being probed by the FHS.

Note that if the Operator sets this parameter incorrectly, the radio detection time can be increased following a BTS restart or upgrade activation.

In all scenarios, the BTS will be able to detect the radio protocol with or without the Operator's use of this parameter.
Description of parameter relationships: If productVariantPlanned is sBTS and 5G is the only one RAT configured (NRBTS exists and GNBTS, WNBTS, LNBTS do not exist), then this parameter must be set to 1 (OBSAI).

Description:
This parameter defines the distinguished name of the radio master. The radio master can be an SMOD/BBMOD or SMOD_EXT.
The SMOD can be directly connected to the radio or indirectly connected via the BBMOD.
Description of parameter relationships:
1. If rfSharingEnabled is set to true and RMOD is connected with SMOD_EXT, then radioMasterDN must be set to related SMOD/BBMOD or SMOD_EXT.

2. If RMOD is not connected with SMOD_EXT and RMOD is not connected to FHS with fhsSharingEnabled = True, then radioMasterDN must not be configured.

3. If RMOD is connected with SMOD_EXT with geranSupport = True, radioMasterDN must be set to related SMOD/BBMOD.

4. If RMOD is connected with SMOD_EXT with utranSupport = True, radioMasterDN must be set to this SMOD_EXT.

5. If radio's CABLINK-linkSpeed = Cpri7:
5.1 If productVariantPlanned = sBTS and RMOD is connected directly to BBMOD and there are only NRCELLs configured on this RMOD and RMOD is connected with SMOD_EXT with eutraSupport = True, radioMasterDN must be set to related SMOD/BBMOD.
5.2 If productVariantPlanned = sBTS and there are no NRCELLs configured on this RMOD and RMOD is connected with SMOD_EXT with nrSupport = True, radioMasterDN must be set to this SMOD_EXT.

6. if radio's CABLINK-linkSpeed = OBSAI (Obsai3Gbps or Obsai6Gbps):
6.1. If productVariantPlanned = sBTS and there are only NRCELLs deployed on this RMOD and RMOD is connected to BBMOD via FHS with MNL-fhsSharingEnabled=False and additionally is connected with SMOD_EXT with eutraSupport or sranSupport = True, radioMasterDN must be set to this SMOD_EXT.
6.2. If productVariantPlanned = sBTS and there are only NRCELLs deployed on this RMOD and RMOD is connected to BBMOD via FHS with MNL-fhsSharingEnabled=True, radioMasterDN must be connected to related BBMOD or can be not configured.
6.3. If productVariantPlanned = sBTS and RMOD is connected directly with SMOD/BBMOD and with SMOD_EXT with nrSupport = True, radioMasterDN must be set to related SMOD/BBMOD.
6.4. If productVariantPlanned = sBTS and RMOD is connected to BBMOD via FHS with MNL-fhsSharingEnabled=True, radioMasterDN must be set to SMOD_EXT with nrSupport equal to TRUE or can be not configured.

7. For RMODs directly connected with SMOD/BBMOD, there must be a CABLINK with one endpoint set to the RMOD DN and another endpoint set to the DN equal to the radioMasterDN.

8. If radioMasterDN is configured, there must not be another RMOD to RMOD CABLINK with the shared RMOD DN as one of the endpoints. i.e. Shared radios cannot be chained.

9.1 If cpriARfSharing is set to SECONDARY, radioMasterDN is ignored.
9.2 If cpriKRfSharing is set to TRUE, radioMasterDN is ignored.

Description:
This parameter contains the first endpoint port label.
If the firstEndpointDN is referencing an SMOD and the secondEndpointDN is referencing a BBMOD, below is the SMOD/BBMOD type and their label configuration descriptions:
- FSMF or FSMFA/FBBx or FBBxA - Label must be set to BB_EXT.
- FSIH/FBIH - Label must be set to BACKPLANE.
- ASxx/ASxxx/ABxx/ABxxL - Label must be set to BACKPLANE.
In dual core, when the firstEndpointDN is referencing an SMOD and the secondEndpointDN is referencing the second SMOD, below is the SMOD/SMOD type and their label configuration descriptions:
- FSMF or FSMFA/FSMF or FSMFA - There must be at least one pair with Label set to SRIO. If RP3 sync is used or radio is shared between the two SMODs within the BTS, there will be another pair with Label set to OPT.
- ASIx/ASIxL - Label must be set to BACKPLANE.
- (ASIA or ASIAL or ASIB or ASIBL)/FSMF or FSMFA - There must be at least one pair with Label set to SRIO. If IQ data routing is used between the two SMODs within the BTS, there will be another pair with Label set to OPT.

For SBTS, LTE BTS and 5G BTS, all fronthaul connections must be labelled as OPT or SFP or QSFP.
Description of parameter relationships:
(1.0) If the firstEndpointDN is referencing an SMOD and the secondEndpointDN is referencing a BBMOD, below is the SMOD/BBMOD type and their label configuration descriptions:
- (FSMF or FSMFA)/FBBx or FBBxA - firstEndpointLabel must be set to BB_EXT.
- FSIH/FBIH- firstEndpointLabel must be set to BACKPLANE.
- ASxx/ASxxx/ABxx/ABxxL - firstEndpointLabel must be set to BACKPLANE.
(1.1) In dual core when the firstEndpointDN is referencing an SMOD and the secondEndpointDN is referencing the second SMOD, below is the SMOD/SMOD type and their label configuration descriptions:
- (FSMF or FSMFA)/(FSMF or FSMFA) - One CABLINK with firstEndpointLabel set to SRIO can be optionally configured. One CABLINK with firstEndpointLabel set to OPT can be optionally configured, firstEndpointPortId must not be duplicated with another firstEndpointDN and firstEndpointPortId combination.
- ASIx/ASIxL- firstEndpointLabel must be set to BACKPLANE.
- (ASIA or ASIAL or ASIB or ASIBL)/(FSMF or FSMFA) - One pair with firstEndpointLabel set to SRIO and firstEndpointPortId set to 1 or 2 (1 if firstEndpoint is FSMF or FSMFA or ASIB or ASIBL side and 1 or 2 is firstEndpoint is ASIA/ASIAL side). If a more pairs exists, firstEndpointLabel must be set to OPT, firstEndpointPortId must not be duplicated with another firstEndpointDN and firstEndpointPortId combination. In AirScale+(FSMF or FSMFA) configuration, if there's OPT firstEndpointLabel configured between AirScale BBMOD and FSMF or FSMFA (SMOD or their BBMODs), there cannot be any two CABLINKs with same RMOD in secondEndpointDN but different SMODs or BBMODs in firstEndpointDN (radio module is not allowed to be split between two system modules).


(2.0) If productVariantPlanned is set to 'sBTS', then the following firstEndpointDN/secondEndpointDN combinations shall have firstEndpointLabel set to OPT
SMOD/RMOD when SMOD module is other than ASOD/ASOE
BBMOD/FHS when BBMOD card is other than ABIL/ABILL, ABIO/ABIOL, ABIN/ABINL, ABIP
FHS/RMOD
RMOD/RMOD
BBMOD/ASIRMOD when BBMOD card is other than ABIL/ABILL, ABIO/ABIOL, ABIN/ABINL, ABIP
ASIRMOD/ASIRMOD
BBMOD/RMOD when BBMOD card is other than ABIL/ABILL, ABIO/ABIOL, ABIN/ABINL, ABIP

(2.1) If there exist CABLINK for which firstEndpointDN refers to a BBMOD card 'ABIL' or 'ABILL' and secondEndpointDN refers to a RMOD/ASIRMOD/FHS instance, firstEndpointLabel shall be equal to either QSFP or SFP.
(2.2) If there exist CABLINK for which firstEndpointDN refers to a BBMOD card 'ABIO'/'ABIOL' or 'ABIN'/'ABINL' and secondEndpointDN refers to a RMOD/ASIRMOD/FHS instance, firstEndpointLabel shall be equal to OPT or SFP.
(2.3) If there exist CABLINK for which firstEndpointDN refers to a SMOD module variant 'ASOE' and secondEndpointDN refers to a RMOD/ASIRMOD/FHS instance, firstEndpointLabel shall be equal to OPT or SFP.
(2.4) If there exist CABLINK for which firstEndpointDN refers to a SMOD module variant 'ASOD' and secondEndpointDN refers to a RMOD instance, firstEndpointLabel shall be equal to SFP or QSFP.
(2.5) If the firstEndpointDN is referencing an SMOD_EXT, firstEndpointLabel shall be set to OPT.

(3.0) If whole set of parameters is defined (CABLINK.firstEndpointDN, CABLINK.firstEndpointLabel and CABLINK.firstEndpointPortId) and CABLINK.firstEndpointLabel is set to value other than QSFP then configuration cannot contain two different CABLINKs with this same set of values. For BBMOD type ABIN/ABINL/ABIO/ABIOL and SMOD type ASOE CABLINK.firstEndpointLabel set to OPT is equivalent with SFP value and vice versa. This rule is not valid for CABLINKS where firstEndpointDN parameter is set to SMOD_EXT.
